# 1. Configuration

```{r init}
# ==============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

# [SELECT EXPERIMENT] "E1" or "E2"
# Set this to distinguish between Results_CPP_E1 and Results_CPP_E2
experiment_id <- "E1" 

# [PROJECT ROOT] Parent of "Results_CPP_E1"
# Ensure this matches your local path
root_dir <- "C:/Code/UG_ERP_Project/results/EEG"

# ==============================================================================
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, stringr, fs, gridExtra, scales, here)

if (!require("eegUtils")) {
  stop("❌ Package 'eegUtils' not found. Please install via devtools.")
}

# Component Spec
comp_specs <- list(
  name = "CPP",
  # Dynamic folder name will be created in loop
  win_ms = c(-300, 50), # Relative to Response
  roi = c("Pz", "Cz", "C1", "C2", "CP1", "CP2"), 
  limits_raw = c(-5.0, 5.0),      
  limits_diff = c(-3.0, 3.0)      
)

emotion_list <- c("aff", "dis", "dom", "enj")
offer_types  <- c("fair", "unfair")

cat(sprintf("🚀 Analysis: CPP | Experiment: %s\n📂 Root: %s\n", experiment_id, root_dir))

```

# 2. Helpers

```{r helpers}
compute_limits <- function(values, symmetric = TRUE) {
  if (all(is.na(values))) return(c(-1, 1))
  max_val <- max(abs(values), na.rm = TRUE)
  max_val <- ceiling(max_val * 10) / 10
  return(if(symmetric) c(-max_val, max_val) else range(values, na.rm=TRUE))
}

plot_topo_unified <- function(dat_long, chan_locs, roi, main, sub, cap, file, lims, cont=TRUE) {
  
  if(!"electrode" %in% names(dat_long)) return(NULL)
  
  p <- topoplot(dat_long, chan_locs=chan_locs, interp_limit="head", contour=cont,
                points=TRUE, highlights=roi, palette="RdBu", limits=lims) +
       labs(title=main, subtitle=sub, caption=cap) +
       theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold"))
  
  ggsave(file, plot=p, device="tiff", width=6, height=6, dpi=300, compression="lzw")
  return(p)
}

```

# 3. Main Pipeline (Regression Only)

```{r main}
# Construct dynamic folder path based on ID
# Example: "Results_CPP_E1"
folder_name <- paste0("Results_", comp_specs$name, "_", experiment_id)
comp_results_dir <- file.path(root_dir, folder_name)

if (!dir_exists(comp_results_dir)) {
  stop(sprintf("❌ Critical: Folder %s not found. Check 'experiment_id' and 'root_dir'.", comp_results_dir))
}

# Find latest session
sessions <- dir_ls(comp_results_dir, glob = "*Session_*", type = "directory")
if (length(sessions) == 0) stop("No sessions found.")
current_session <- sort(sessions, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
cat(sprintf("📍 Session: %s\n", basename(current_session)))

# Load Data
chan_file <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "channel_locations.csv")
data_file <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "topomap_data_for_R", paste0(comp_specs$name, "_topomap_data.csv"))

if (!file.exists(chan_file) || !file.exists(data_file)) stop("❌ Data files missing.")

chanlocs <- read_csv(chan_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename(electrode = channel)
topo_data <- read_csv(data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ==============================================================================
# CALCULATE DIFFERENCES & MAIN EFFECTS (Corrected Logic)
# ==============================================================================
cat("🧮 Calculating Differences & Main Effects...\n")

# 1. Conditional Differences (Emotion - Neutral within Offer)
for(o in offer_types) {
  neu_col <- paste0("raw_neu_", o)
  for(e in emotion_list) {
    tgt <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", o)
    if(neu_col %in% names(topo_data) & tgt %in% names(topo_data)) 
      topo_data[[paste0("conditional_diff_", e, "_vs_neu_", o)]] <- topo_data[[tgt]] - topo_data[[neu_col]]
  }
  
  # 2. Offer Main Effect (Average across all emotions for this offer type)
  cols <- paste0("raw_", c("neu", emotion_list), "_", o)
  valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
  if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("offer_main_", o)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
}

# 3. Emotion Main Effect (Average across offer types for this emotion)
for(e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
  cols <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", offer_types)
  valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
  if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
  
  # Emotion Main Diff (vs Neutral)
  if(e != "neu" && paste0("emotion_main_", e) %in% names(topo_data) && "emotion_main_neu" %in% names(topo_data)) {
     topo_data[[paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")]] <- topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] - topo_data[["emotion_main_neu"]]
  }
}

# 4. Offer Main Diff (Unfair - Fair)
if("offer_main_unfair" %in% names(topo_data) && "offer_main_fair" %in% names(topo_data)) 
  topo_data[["offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair"]] <- topo_data[["offer_main_unfair"]] - topo_data[["offer_main_fair"]]

# Prepare for plotting
topo_long <- topo_data %>% rename(electrode = channel)

# Output Setup
out_base <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "topoplots_R")
dir_map <- c("raw", "diff", "offer_diff", "emotion_main", "emotion_diff")
walk(file.path(out_base, dir_map), dir_create)

# Limits
lims_raw  <- if(!is.null(comp_specs$limits_raw)) comp_specs$limits_raw else compute_limits(unlist(topo_long[, grep("^raw_", names(topo_long))]))
lims_diff <- if(!is.null(comp_specs$limits_diff)) comp_specs$limits_diff else compute_limits(unlist(topo_long[, grep("^conditional_diff_", names(topo_long))]))

cat("📊 Generating Plots...\n")

# [A] Raw
for (ofr in offer_types) {
  for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
    col <- paste0("raw_", emo, "_", ofr)
    if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
      plot_topo_unified(
        select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)),
        chanlocs, comp_specs$roi,
        "CPP Regression-Corrected", paste(ofr, emo, sep=" | "), "-300 to 50ms",
        file.path(out_base, "raw", paste0("CPP_", ofr, "_", emo, ".tiff")),
        lims_raw
      )
    }
  }
}

# [B] Conditional Diff
for (ofr in offer_types) {
  for (emo in emotion_list) {
    col <- paste0("conditional_diff_", emo, "_vs_neu_", ofr)
    if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
      plot_topo_unified(
        select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)),
        chanlocs, comp_specs$roi,
        "CPP Difference", paste(ofr, paste0(emo, "-neu"), sep=" | "), "Diff Wave",
        file.path(out_base, "diff", paste0("CPP_diff_", ofr, "_", emo, "_vs_neu.tiff")),
        lims_diff, cont=FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

# [C] Offer Main Diff
if ("offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair" %in% names(topo_long)) {
  plot_topo_unified(
    select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair),
    chanlocs, comp_specs$roi,
    "CPP Main Effect", "Unfair - Fair", "Main Diff",
    file.path(out_base, "offer_diff", "CPP_diff_unfair_vs_fair.tiff"),
    lims_diff, cont=FALSE
  )
}

# [D] Emotion Main Effect (Added for completeness)
for (e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
  col <- paste0("emotion_main_", e)
  if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
     plot_topo_unified(
      select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chanlocs, comp_specs$roi,
      "CPP Main Effect", paste0("Emotion: ", e), "Avg across Offers",
      file.path(out_base, "emotion_main", paste0("CPP_main_emotion_", e, ".tiff")),
      lims_raw
    )
  }
}

# [E] Emotion Main Diff (Added for completeness)
for (e in emotion_list) {
  col <- paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")
  if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
     plot_topo_unified(
      select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chanlocs, comp_specs$roi,
      "CPP Main Effect Diff", paste0(e, " - Neu"), "Diff Wave",
      file.path(out_base, "emotion_diff", paste0("CPP_main_diff_", e, "_vs_neu.tiff")),
      lims_diff, cont=FALSE
    )
  }
}

cat(sprintf("✅ Done. Outputs: %s\n", out_base))

```
